{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Yarden Bond — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Yarden Bond]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Yarden Bond]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Yarden Bond]]'s Engineer services in Bayan.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Yarden Bond is discovered through [[Kit Fowler]].
* '''Invitation:''' There is no separate invitation requirement after [[Kit Fowler]] has referred Yarden.
* Unlock [[Domino Green]].
* Provide Domino with Push to discover [[Kit Fowler]].
* Provide Kit with '''5 Surveillance Equipment''' to discover Yarden Bond.
* Obtain '''5 Smear Campaign Plans'''.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
'''Obtaining Smear Campaign Plans'''
Smear Campaign Plans are Odyssey '''Data'''.

Current material data lists them as obtainable from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings''';
* data ports in '''CMD buildings'''; and
* '''mission rewards'''.

Because Smear Campaign Plans are Data, they do not occupy the physical Goods section of the suit backpack.

They currently have no known suit or weapon modification recipe and are used for Engineer progression.

{{Tip|HAB and CMD data ports contain large possible Data pools, so a single settlement visit is not guaranteed to provide a Smear Campaign Plan. Check mission rewards as well rather than relying entirely on random settlement downloads.}}

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Unlock [[Domino Green]].
# Provide Domino with Push to discover [[Kit Fowler]].
# Complete Kit Fowler's unlock requirement.
# Provide Kit with '''5 Surveillance Equipment''' to discover Yarden Bond.
# Obtain '''5 Smear Campaign Plans'''.
# Sell the Smear Campaign Plans to bartenders.
# Travel to '''Salamander Bank''' on '''Bayan 7 b'''.
# Access Yarden Bond's Engineer workshop.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Yarden Bond]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
